nodes.author: iNath2024
nodes.text: @AskNigeriaNews HMPV is really becoming a concern for Nigeria, and it’s important that we take proactive measures to prevent outbreaks as infections continue to rise. Protecting public health should be a top priority.

nodes.author: AkinbuwaOl56244
nodes.text: @AskNigeriaNews Nigeria must prioritize public health measures, improve healthcare infrastructure, and enhance disease surveillance to combat potential HMPV outbreaks during harmattan. Lessons from COVID-19 are crucial for preparedness.

nodes.author: Usmanhakeem17
nodes.text: @AskNigeriaNews Need of preventive measures to curb the outbreak of the infection going around the outbreak of the disease is similar to COVID 19 and there is no cure yet so we need to create awareness so people can know how to prevent themselves from the disease outbreaks

nodes.author: TaiwoAyo36
nodes.text: @AskNigeriaNews To protect its people from respiratory diseases, Nigeria must invest in healthcare resilience and implement preventative measures. bolstering the infrastructure for healthcare and enhancing monitoring of diseases

nodes.author: Hassanissa43604
nodes.text: @AskNigeriaNews Raising awareness of the rising number of illness cases that are occurring, especially in children under the age of 14, is necessary. Since there is now no specific treatment for this condition preventive measures are required urgently
